notes.title: Big content update
notes.notes:
We just rolled out a massive update for Chickenauts! Inside the newest build you will find:
[list]
[*] Three unique chicken companions encourage different play styles.
[*] Updated environments and a new boss with lightsabers.
[*] Run modifiers for additional challenge.
[*] Various weapons to match your play style based on companions.
[/list]

Enjoy the ride and always let us know if you have any feedback inside the community tab on steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154978/14c0a3b7e39b8da5acba30b7784cbd86b8fa05a7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming demo update
notes.notes:
Happy festive season everyone! We plan to introduce a new update to the demo around December 1st. Here are some new things we're adding.

[h2]Persistent progression[/h2]
In this update we plan to focus on adding some additional persistent progression upgrades to the game where you'll be able to empower yourself using a mysterious substance brought back from the ship.

[h2]Grandma![/h2]
A new NPC is also arriving to the farm! Grandma (whodoesn't have a name yet) will be present to help the player throughout the runs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154978/ea77b4970d232019c033bea52c8418b385196fca.png[/img]

[h2]New map[/h2]
And finally we plan to better show the place where the player is fighting so we will be adding an environment map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154978/c4d856816cc69262b04487ea44fd6750cc94554c.png[/img]

notes.title: Chickenauts Demo Release #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

We are pleased to announce that a new [b]demo[/b] for Chickenauts is now available on Steam. 

[b]This update includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Chicken Companions:[/b] Free your adducted chickens and then mutate them to help you in your battles. 
[*] [b]Potions:[/b] In Spaceship you will be able to find potions that have random generated effects that can lead to crazy events.
[*] [b]Updated Level Art and Design:[/b] We heard your feedback and we complexly remade our levels, including art and design.
[*] [b]New upgrades and mutations:[/b] Not only more upgrades for player but now you also can mutate your companion.
[*] [b]Talking NPCs:[/b] Interact with a variety of NPCs who offer stories, quests, and valuable information.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Experience smoother gameplay with several bug fixes and improvements.
[*] [b]New Weapons:[/b] We introducing melee weapons.
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/hpFAvQQK][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154978/48cc0fd72c5eb879501d6f896cd09f334c2512b5.png[/img][/url]

Additionally, we are excited to announce the launch of our official Chickenauts Discord server. Join our [b]Discord[/b] server here: https://discord.gg/hpFAvQQK

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new features!

Best Regards,

The Chickenauts Team
